Name: Siasz's Abigail Portraits
Author: Siasz
Description: I am surprised by how much fun I had drawing Abigail, I wasn't too excited to draw her to begin with but I'm so happy I did it. So a few touches Id like to mention that I added is: I gave her slightly pointed ears due to  some info we know about Abigail in game that I don't want to spoil, but since the wizard did tell us that we can see things others can't, I figured it would be a cute detail to add her with that the other NPC's can't see on her. I did the same with her eyes, in her Vanilla portraits when shes angry they have a red tint, so I added that in there as another little "only we can see" aspects. Hope you enjoy! Let me know if you'd like something done differently and which character I should do next!

Downloads.Description: Download the file, go into the zipped folder, copy and paste the image into the portraiture mod where your other images are, if it asks to replace any existing images, click yes.
